# ttvl.co

> Personal website of Toto Tvalavadze featuring photography documentation, notebook system templates, personal essays, and various creative projects. 

This site serves as a digital garden and documentation hub for various personal and creative projects, with a strong focus on analog photography, notebook systems, and thoughtful writing.

## Photography & Darkroom

- [Darkroom](/darkroom/): Technical documentation and guides for analog photography.
  - [Film Identification Format](/darkroom/roll-id/): Guide for identifying and tracking film rolls.
  - [Travel Film Development Kit](/darkroom/travel-dev-kit): Portable darkroom setup.
  - [Bulk Film Canister Stickers](/darkroom/canister-stickers): DIY film canister labeling system.
  - [Valoi Easy120 with Negative Supply Light](/darkroom/valoi-easy120-with-negative-supply-99cri-light): A 3D-printable adapter that marries two popular systems for film scanning into a single system that produces good colors.

## Notebook System

- [Unbound Notebook System](/notebook-system/), or UNS: Framework for hybrid digital and analog note-taking system that Toto developed and is using.
  - [Analog Photography Templates](/notebook-system/analog-photography-templates/): Templates for film photography workflow.
  - [General Templates](/notebook-system/general-templates/): Basic notebook templates.
  - [Make Your Own](/notebook-system/make-your-own/): Guide to creating custom UNS notebook.

## Projects

- [Project Humane](/project-humane/): Tools and toys Toto makes for productiivty and work.
  - [EDC Keychain](/project-humane/edc-keychain/): Everyday carry system to carry daily esentantials that do not fit into men's pant pockets.
  - [Soma](/project-humane/soma/): A macOS app (work inprogress) to scan loose leafs and transcribe them into a text documents. 

## Technical Information

- [Colophon](/colophon/): Technical details about the website.
- [About](/about/): Information about Toto Tvalavadze.
- [Philosophy](/philosophy/): Core principles and approach of Toto.

## Optional

- [Objects](/objects/): Documentation of physical objects and tools Toto is using or have used.
- [Newsletter](/newsletter/): Archive of newsletter content.
